title: 2024 Egyptian-Japanese radar survey finds L-shaped structure near Great Pyramid

tellings.quote: In 2024, a collaborative effort between Egyptian and Japanese researchers using ground penetrating radar and electrical resistivity tomography mapped the western cemetery adjacent to the Great Pyramid.

plain: In 2024, a joint team of Egyptian and Japanese researchers is said to have found an L-shaped structure underground in the western cemetery beside the Great Pyramid of Giza. Michels tells this himself in an episode about the pyramids, saying the team mapped the site with ground-penetrating radar and electrical resistivity tomography, two ways of seeing what lies below the surface without digging. He raises it as a sign that there may be more under Giza than is known.
